Meta.title: Taksu Tech: receptionist and education robots in Bali
Meta.description: Taksu Tech, part of Ezra Robotics, brings the Timo and Snow receptionist robots to hotels and public-service offices in Bali, plus education robot kits for primary to senior high school.

hero.title: Robots that greet your guests with Om Swastiastu
hero.body: Taksu Tech brings the Timo and Snow receptionist robots to hotels and public-service offices in Bali, plus education robot kits from primary to senior high school.
hero.panelCaption: A preview of our receptionist robot screen
hero.writerLabel: Write your name in Aksara Bali
hero.writerPlaceholder: Type a name, for example Made
hero.writerHint: A plain e reads like the e in Ketut. Type é for the sound in Madé.
hero.writerEmpty: Your Aksara Bali will appear here

lines.title: Two product lines
lines.intro: One team in Bali that installs, teaches, and maintains the robots.
lines.commercialBody: Timo and Snow, Taksu Tech receptionist robots configured for Bali: queues, directions, organisation charts, an AI assistant, and Aksara Bali on screen.
lines.educationBody: Kits for primary, junior, and senior high school that grow with students: from blocks, to C++, to ROS 2 and AI.

demos.title: Try it in your browser
demos.intro: Every demo runs in the browser with no sign-in. Open one on a tablet to get a feel for the robot screen.
demos.launcher: Pick your own robot and sample venue

useCases.title: Where our robots work
useCases.intro: Every venue moves guests differently. We tailor the robot’s content and routes to each one.

bali.title: Made for Bali
bali.intro: We write our own kiosk software, so local customs can be part of the robot.
bali.nextHoly: {name} in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

aksara.title: Aksara Bali on screen
aksara.body: Venue names appear in Balinese script above the Latin, the way signs are written across Bali.

pawukon.title: Knows the Pawukon calendar
pawukon.body: The robot knows when it is Galungan, Kuningan, or Saraswati and adjusts its greetings and information.

salam.title: Greetings and etiquette
salam.body: Om Swastiastu to open, suksma to say thanks, and customs tips for international guests.

language.title: Two languages, ready for more
language.body: Indonesian and English are built in. Other languages for visitors can be added per venue.

path.title: How students learn at every level
path.intro: Students always try a program in the simulator first, then run it on the real robot.

cta.title: Want to see the robots in person?
cta.body: We can visit your venue in Bali for a demo and a site survey.

Robots.metaDescription: Taksu Tech receptionist robots for hotels, resorts, and public-service offices in Bali: queues, directions, an AI assistant, and Aksara Bali.
Robots.title: Receptionist robots for Bali
Robots.intro: Timo and Snow come with kiosk software we build ourselves. We tailor the content, languages, and routes to your venue.

process.title: How we install a robot
process.intro: From the site survey to a robot at work in your lobby.

survey.title: Site survey
survey.body: We map guest flow, service points, and the network at your venue.

mapping.title: Mapping and content
mapping.body: The robot maps the building. We load information, queues, and the organisation chart.

install.title: Installation and training
install.body: Staff learn to operate the robot and update its content themselves.

support.title: Ongoing support
support.body: Maintenance and software updates from our team in Bali.

software.title: Taksu kiosk software
software.intro: Runs on both robots’ 13.3-inch touchscreens. Turn each feature on to suit the venue.

queue.title: Queue tickets
queue.body: Numbers per service, with an estimated waiting time.

wayfinding.title: Directions
wayfinding.body: A floor map, the shortest route, and a robot that walks you there.

organization.title: Organisation chart
organization.body: Who is responsible for what, and which room they are in.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.body: Answers questions from your venue’s own information, out loud.

aksara.title: Aksara Bali
aksara.body: Writes a guest’s name in Balinese script, a keepsake visitors love.

calendar.title: Holy-day calendar
calendar.body: Greetings and notices that follow the Pawukon holy days.

RobotDetail.demoBody: This demo shows {name}’s screen at {site}: greetings, queue tickets, directions, and the AI assistant.

Education.metaTitle: Education robots for primary to senior high school
Education.metaDescription: Modular education robot kits by Taksu Tech: block programming for primary school, Arduino and ESP32 for junior high, ROS 2 and AI for senior high.
Education.title: Education robots from primary to senior high
Education.intro: One ecosystem that grows with students. Robots, modules, and lessons connect across levels, so schools never start from zero when students move up.
Education.pathIntro: The same four steps at every level.
Education.modularIntro: Plug, program, or bolt on parts to match each student’s idea.

modular.result: A robot of the student’s own design

Education.upgradeIntro: Every platform is compatible and can be upgraded at any time.
Education.supportIntro: We stay with schools after the purchase, not only at delivery.
Education.syllabusBody: A {meetings}-meeting syllabus per level, prepared for the {competitions} competition tracks.

Level.demoBody: Snap blocks together, run them, and watch the robot move in the simulator. The same program can be uploaded to the robot.
Level.demoSoon: A 3D simulation demo for this level is in preparation. Contact us for a live demo.

Demo.metaTitle: Receptionist robot and block coding demos
Demo.metaDescription: Try the Timo and Snow receptionist robot screens and the block-coding playground for primary and junior high school, right in your browser.
Demo.title: Demo
Demo.intro: Every demo runs in the browser. The venue data inside is sample data and can be replaced with your own.
Demo.kioskIntro: The robot’s touchscreen with queue tickets, directions, the organisation chart, and the AI assistant.
Demo.playgroundIntro: Block coding as in class, with a robot simulator set in a rice field.
Demo.launcherBody: Pick the robot and sample venue you want to try, then open it full screen.
Demo.tip: Tip: open it on a tablet in landscape for the closest feel to the robot.

About.metaDescription: Taksu Tech is part of Ezra Robotics and focuses on service robots and robotics education in Bali.
About.title: About Taksu Tech
About.parentBody: Ezra Robotics integrates robots for inspection, safety, and commercial services across Indonesia. Taksu Tech is its Bali-focused unit: service robots for tourism and public services, and robotics education for schools.
About.valuesTitle: Tri Hita Karana in how we work
About.valuesIntro: Three sources of harmony in Balinese philosophy, and what they mean for our products.
About.aksaraTitle: About the Aksara Bali on this site
About.aksaraBody: The Balinese script on this site and kiosk is generated by our transliteration library. For official signage and content, we review the output with Balinese speakers and language advisers.

Contact.metaDescription: Request a quote or book a demo of Taksu Tech receptionist and education robots in Bali.
Contact.title: Contact us
Contact.intro: Tell us about your venue or school and what you want to achieve. We will get back to you to schedule a demo.
